changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: SELECT 0 AS digit UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: SELECT ones.digit + tens.digit * 10 + hundreds.digit * 100 + thousands.digit * 1000 AS number FROM VW_DIGITS as ones, VW_DIGITS as tens, VW_DIGITS as hundreds, VW_DIGITS as thousands

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: SELECT CAST((GETDATE()-number) as Date) AS date FROM VW_NUMBERS

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: select d.date osdates,OS_ID AS datesos,appId from VW_DATES d,TB_OS o,VW_NOTIFY_APPID ap

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: select CAST(tnl.CREATED_TS AS DATE) AS TXNDATE,count(0) AS num,tnm.OS_ID AS os,tnl.APP_ID AS appId from TB_ASNF_TXN_LOG tnl,TB_ASNF_DEVICES_MASTER tnm where tnl.NOTIF_REG_ID = tnm.NOTIF_REG_ID group by CAST(tnl.CREATED_TS AS DATE),tnm.OS_ID,tnl.APP_ID

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: SELECT VW_OS_DATES.appId,osdates,COALESCE(num,0) count,datesos FROM VW_MESSAGE_STATS RIGHT OUTER JOIN VW_OS_DATES ON osdates=TXNDATE AND datesos=os and VW_OS_DATES.appId=VW_MESSAGE_STATS.appId

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: SELECT * FROM TB_ASTP_LAST_LOGIN A where A.SESSION_ID IS NOT NULL AND abs(DATEDIFF("second",GETDATE(),LAST_REQ_TIME)) < (SELECT SESSION_TIMEOUT FROM TB_ASMI_SECURITY_PARAMETERS C WHERE A.APP_ID=C.APP_ID)

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: SELECT B.OS,A.APP_ID, COUNT(*) as COUNT FROM TB_ASTP_LAST_LOGIN A,TB_ASMI_DEVICE_MASTER B WHERE A.APP_ID =B.APP_ID AND A.DEVICE_ID = B.DEVICE_ID AND A.SESSION_ID IS NOT NULL AND abs(DATEDIFF("second",GETDATE(),LAST_REQ_TIME)) < (SELECT SESSION_TIMEOUT FROM TB_ASMI_SECURITY_PARAMETERS C WHERE C.APP_ID=A.APP_ID) GROUP BY B.OS, A.APP_ID union all SELECT A.DEVICE_ID,A.APP_ID, COUNT(*) as COUNT FROM TB_ASTP_LAST_LOGIN A WHERE A.DEVICE_ID IN ('WEB','SIMULATOR') AND A.SESSION_ID IS NOT NULL AND abs(DATEDIFF("second",GETDATE(),LAST_REQ_TIME)) < (SELECT SESSION_TIMEOUT FROM TB_ASMI_SECURITY_PARAMETERS C WHERE C.APP_ID=A.APP_ID) GROUP BY A.DEVICE_ID, A.APP_ID

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: SELECT t1.APP_ID, CAST(t1.CREATE_TS AS DATE) as CREATE_TS, count(*) as ACTIVE , 0 INACTIVE FROM TB_ASMI_USER t1 LEFT JOIN TB_ASTP_LAST_LOGIN t2 ON t2.USER_ID = t1.USER_ID AND t2.APP_ID = t1.APP_ID WHERE t2.USER_ID IS NOT NULL AND t1.USER_ACTIVE='Y' GROUP BY t1.APP_ID, CAST(t1.CREATE_TS AS DATE) UNION ALL SELECT t1.APP_ID,CAST(t1.CREATE_TS AS DATE) as CREATE_TS, 0 ACTIVE, count(*) as INACTIVE FROM TB_ASMI_USER t1 LEFT JOIN TB_ASTP_LAST_LOGIN t2 ON t2.USER_ID = t1.USER_ID AND t2.APP_ID = t1.APP_ID WHERE t2.USER_ID IS NULL AND t1.USER_ACTIVE='Y' GROUP BY t1.APP_ID, CAST(t1.CREATE_TS AS DATE)

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: select tb.APP_ID,tb.DEVICE_ID,CAST(tb.CREATE_TS AS Date) as AccessDate,count(*) as TotalTxns,0 Logins,0 DistinctLogins from TB_ASLG_TXN_DETAIL tb where tb.TXN_STAT='S' group by tb.APP_ID,tb.DEVICE_ID,CAST(tb.CREATE_TS AS Date) union all select tb2.APP_ID,tb2.DEVICE_ID,CAST(tb2.CREATE_TS AS Date) as AccessDate,0 TotalTxns,count(*) as Logins, count(distinct CAST(tb2.CREATE_TS AS Date)) as DistinctLogins from TB_ASLG_TXN_DETAIL tb2 where (tb2.INTERFACE_ID='appzillonReLoginRequest' OR tb2.INTERFACE_ID='appzillonAuthenticationRequest') and tb2.TXN_STAT='S' Group by tb2.APP_ID,tb2.USER_ID,tb2.DEVICE_ID,CAST(tb2.CREATE_TS AS Date)

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: SELECT tb.APP_ID,tb.USER_ID,tb.SESSION_ID, abs(DATEDIFF("MILLISECOND",MAX(END_TM),MIN(ST_TM))) tm, count(*) as TotalTxns,count(distinct(tb.INTERFACE_ID)) as DistinctTxns, 0 Logins, 0 DistinctLogins FROM TB_ASLG_TXN_DETAIL tb WHERE tb.TXN_STAT='S' GROUP BY tb.APP_ID, tb.USER_ID, tb.SESSION_ID UNION ALL SELECT tb2.APP_ID,tb2.USER_ID, null SESSION_ID, null tm, 0 TotalTxns,0 DistinctTxns,count(*) as Logins, count(distinct CAST(tb2.CREATE_TS AS Date)) as DistinctLogins FROM TB_ASLG_TXN_DETAIL tb2 WHERE (tb2.INTERFACE_ID='appzillonReLoginRequest' OR tb2.INTERFACE_ID='appzillonAuthenticationRequest') and tb2.TXN_STAT='S' GROUP BY tb2.APP_ID, tb2.USER_ID

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: SELECT APP_ID,USER_ID,COUNT(LONGITUDE) as COUNT_LON, LONGITUDE, COUNT(LATITUDE) as COUNT_LAT,LATITUDE, FORMATTED_ADDRESS FROM TB_ASLG_TXN_DETAIL GROUP BY LONGITUDE, LATITUDE, FORMATTED_ADDRESS, APP_ID, USER_ID

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: SELECT APP_ID,USER_ID,CAST(CREATE_TS AS Date) AS AccessDate,SESSION_ID,min(ST_TM) as ST_TM,max(END_TM) as END_TM,Count(*) As TotalTxns,0 DistinctTxns,LATITUDE,LONGITUDE,FORMATTED_ADDRESS FROM TB_ASLG_TXN_DETAIL WHERE TXN_STAT='S' GROUP by APP_ID,USER_ID,CAST(CREATE_TS AS Date),SESSION_ID,LATITUDE,LONGITUDE,FORMATTED_ADDRESS UNION ALL SELECT APP_ID,USER_ID,CAST(CREATE_TS AS Date) AS AccessDate,SESSION_ID,min(ST_TM) as ST_TM,max(END_TM) as END_TM,0 TotalTxns, Count(distinct(INTERFACE_ID)) AS DistinctTxns,LATITUDE,LONGITUDE,FORMATTED_ADDRESS FROM TB_ASLG_TXN_DETAIL WHERE TXN_STAT='S' GROUP BY APP_ID,USER_ID,CAST(CREATE_TS AS Date),SESSION_ID,INTERFACE_ID,LATITUDE,LONGITUDE,FORMATTED_ADDRESS

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: SELECT txn.APP_ID,CAST(txn.CREATE_TS AS Date) AS AccessDate,intf.DESCRIPTION, txn.TXN_STAT, MIN(abs(DATEDIFF("MILLISECOND",txn.END_TM,txn.ST_TM))) AS MinTime, MAX(abs(DATEDIFF("MILLISECOND",txn.END_TM,txn.ST_TM))) AS MaxTime, AVG(abs(DATEDIFF("MILLISECOND",txn.END_TM,txn.ST_TM))) AS AvgTime, count(txn.INTERFACE_ID) AS IntfCount FROM TB_ASLG_TXN_DETAIL txn, TB_ASMI_INTF_MASTER intf WHERE txn.INTERFACE_ID = intf.INTERFACE_ID GROUP BY txn.APP_ID,txn.INTERFACE_ID,CAST(txn.CREATE_TS AS Date),intf.DESCRIPTION,txn.TXN_STAT

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: SELECT APP_ID, DEVICE_GROUP_ID, DEVICE_GROUP_DESCRIPTION, OS,HEIGHT, WIDTH, 'PORTRAIT' AS ORIENTATION FROM TB_ASMI_DEVICE_GRPS WHERE ORIENTATION_LOCK = 'ANY' UNION ALL SELECT APP_ID, DEVICE_GROUP_ID, DEVICE_GROUP_DESCRIPTION, OS,HEIGHT, WIDTH, 'LANDSCAPE' AS ORIENTATION FROM TB_ASMI_DEVICE_GRPS WHERE ORIENTATION_LOCK = 'ANY' UNION ALL SELECT APP_ID, DEVICE_GROUP_ID, DEVICE_GROUP_DESCRIPTION, OS,HEIGHT, WIDTH, ORIENTATION_LOCK AS ORIENTATION FROM TB_ASMI_DEVICE_GRPS WHERE ORIENTATION_LOCK != 'ANY'

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: SELECT T2.APP_ID AS APP_ID, T2.SCREEN_ID, T2.MICRO_APP_ID AS MICRO_APP_ID, T1.APP_NAME AS MICRO_APP_NAME, T1.APP_ICON AS MICRO_APP_ICON, T1.MICRO_APP_TYPE AS MICRO_APP_TYPE FROM TB_ASMI_APP_MASTER T1, TB_ASMI_SCREEN_MICRO_APP T2 WHERE T1.APP_ID = T2.MICRO_APP_ID AND T1.BASE_APP = 'N'

changeSet.author: platform
changeSet.createView: SELECT T1.APP_ID, T2.SCREEN_ID, T1.SCREEN_ID AS CALLFORM_ID, T1.SCREEN_NAME AS CALLFORM_NAME, T1.SCREEN_ICON AS CALLFORM_ICON FROM TB_ASMI_SCR_MASTER T1, TB_ASMI_SCREEN_WIDGETS T2 WHERE T1.APP_ID = T2.APP_ID AND T1.SCREEN_ID = T2.CALLFORM_ID AND T1.SCREEN_TYPE = 'CALL'
